A_5_method: direct streamed meet-in-the-middle weight-5 count on G0 (16x519): A_5 = #{weight-5 codewords of G0^perp} = B_5 (validated regime, all min-weight dual codewords logical). MacWilliams infeasible here (5^16=1.5e11); the count is dim(G0)-independent. Tool: qmsd.weightcount.count_weight_d (sequential) / parallel i-stripe driver.
A_5_baseline_vs_optimized: best of flat-spread (line-spread of AG(4,5), maxline=3) d=5 puncture sets: A_5 in {1904..2168} over ~10 sampled sets, median ~2084; this set is the minimum (1904).
span_note: j=2 (plane) contribution to A_5 is 0 for this line-spread set; A_5 lives entirely at affine span j=3 and j=4. The structured flat-decomposition (qmsd.structured_ad) cannot enumerate j=3/j=4 here in reasonable time (j=3 ~9e9 per-flat MITM entries; the single whole-space j=4 flat cannot be pruned since min_span_weight(4)<=32<=k+5), so A_5 was obtained by the direct whole-space weight-5 count instead.
distance_certification: d=5 certified by qmsd.mindist.min_dependent_columns(G0,5,d_max=6) (no dependent column set of size<5; a weight-5 set exists).
